## Invitations

During the reporting period, the outreach programme issued 2468 invitations across the Hill Counties area. Attendance totalled 871, representing a rate of 35.3. This provides a clear summary of reach and participation during the period. The attendance figure is presented alongside the invitation total to support review of engagement.

The results indicate that a substantial number of invitations were issued, while attendance was recorded for a smaller group of invitees. These figures will support ongoing review of the outreach approach and help inform future contact activity.

## Contact

SMS contact was used with 2093 invitations. A reminder message was also received by 2093 people. The matching totals provide a consistent account of the recorded SMS and reminder activity. Together, these contacts formed the main recorded follow-up activity associated with the invitations and attendance reported above.

The information is provided for routine monitoring and service review. Prepared by G. Evans.
